ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 88% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage in the central fluke region against 12% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage localized to the perimeter trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white blob occupies the center and lower fluke area. A continuous, irregular low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge, increasing in thickness at the distal tips. Sparse, low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) are detected in the lower-right and lower-left interior quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing boundary. Notable high-amplitude peaks (sawtooth pattern) are concentrated on the outer two-thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave upward curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the sharp, elevated distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular semi-circular notch (traumatic amputation or wear) located on the right trailing edge approximately 60% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips show an unusually wide and jagged distribution of low-intensity black pigmentation compared to the thinner banding at the center of the trailing edge.
